scope.excluded_teeth_gomphoses: Teeth are not bones; tooth-socket fibrous gomphoses are documented but excluded from the 206 bone-to-bone inventory. Adult dentition variable; no jaw motion is lost.
scope.additional_structures_outside_206: Cartilage, TFCC, ligaments, sternal/hip subcomponents and hallux sesamoids have separate IDs and do not change the conventional count.
scope.granularity: One articulation per named capsule/contact complex, bilateral facets separately; multipart contact participants explicit. Not a universal clinical joint count.
scope.internal_fusions: Sacral, hip, frontal and mandibular adult fusions are internal to the conventional count. Hyoid/coccygeal joints and sternal junctions are explicitly represented as subcomponent interfaces. Four coccygeal components is a reference convention; 3-5/fusion variants require fitting metadata.
scope.acceptance: Inventory classification only. Does not certify joint axes, ROM, character fit, or dynamic motion.
scope.coccyx_inventory_caveat: The preserved Phase 1 adult_fused flag describes the conventional one-bone accounting, not proof all coccygeal interfaces are fused. This inventory deliberately reopens that anatomical assumption.

hyoid.reason: No osseous articulation. Suspended by soft tissues; requires a reference/follower transform, not a fictitious bone joint.
